update.title: Fixed artifact rendering across the portfolio pipeline
update.summary: Aligned Work Report previews, Portfolio Editor path handling, saved media, detail-page blocks, and browser revalidation so artifacts stay usable from capture through the rendered page.

blocks.body:
## Make every artifact recognizable before import

Work Report cards now preview image, code, terminal, video, document, and data evidence before it enters a draft. When staged material still carries an absolute filesystem path, Portfolio Editor's preview bridge routes it through the artifact-preview endpoint and supplies the live page with a valid preview URL.

blocks.alt: Work Report card titled Test: All 6 artifact types with preview cards for image, code, terminal, video, document, and data evidence
blocks.caption: Work Report cards distinguish all six evidence categories before they enter the draft.

blocks.body:
## Preserve artifacts through save and render

Saving now copies local video alongside other asset-bearing blocks and rewrites its source to a project-relative media path. The detail renderer uses native video playback for local files and an iframe for supported hosted media. Shared path resolution covers images, galleries, comparisons, and PDFs through the same preview and save flow.

blocks.caption: One artifact keeps a traceable path from Work Report preview to editor state and saved detail-page output.
blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Report[Work Report card] --> Draft[Editor draft]
  Draft --> Preview[Live preview]
  Draft --> Media[Saved project media]
  Media --> Page[Detail-page blocks]
  Assets[Updated renderer files] --> Refresh[Browser revalidation]
  Refresh --> Page
blocks.summary: Artifact evidence moves from a Work Report card into an editor draft, branches into live preview and saved project media, and reaches the detail page alongside revalidated renderer files.

blocks.body:
## Revalidate renderer assets after changes

HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and project manifest responses now ask the browser to revalidate on navigation. ETags keep unchanged files lightweight while updated renderer code takes effect immediately.
